selection.ownership: Fireberry Ltd, formerly Powerlink (Tel Aviv, Israel). International English REST edition at api.fireberry.com; not the api.powerlink.co.il host.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Fireberry REST docs (tokenid header, https://api.fireberry.com/api, GET /record/account, GUID path, pagesize/pagenumber GET pagination 50/10), security/trust overview, company identity (Israeli Powerlink rebrand going global), and dated incident search. This is the international Fireberry REST API, not the Hebrew Powerlink.co.il edition. No qualifying current unresolved Fireberry compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Fireberry REST API uses host https://api.fireberry.com, tokenid header (the documented curl example; prose also mentions Authorization), GET /api/record/account with pagesize 1–50 and pagenumber 1–10, and GUID path segments. Operator is Fireberry Ltd in Tel Aviv (Powerlink rebrand). Israeli HQ is not mainland-China. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found availability incidents, not a qualifying unresolved customer-data compromise.

incidents.finding: Published security materials describe encryption, access control, and incident response. Bounded search found Fireberry availability incidents, not a current unresolved data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified. Native bodyErrorPaths cannot invert the success boolean, so HTTP status remains the failure signal for these GET reads.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck probes GET /api/record/account?pagesize=1&pagenumber=1, matching the pinned validator, and accepts empty input.
Native category is crm: Fireberry is a CRM. Source Productivity/Marketing are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
Quick Start prose mentions an Authorization header; the documented example and pinned source send tokenid. Native auth follows tokenid.
Returns raw Fireberry JSON under data. Official GET query names are pagesize (1–50) and pagenumber (1–10).
